resources.string: Platforms and games from your RoMM server
This game folder contains additional files. Manage it in your file manager
Checks Tandem with RoMM support on GitHub. Update verifies the download and installed signing key before handing off to Android. Android may ask for permission or confirmation.
Check GitHub when the library gains focus, at most once a day after a successful check. Private mode pauses update checks.
Install verified updates while Tandem is in front and RoMM downloads are idle. Automatic checks and Android\'s install permission must be enabled. Tandem restarts; Android may ask to confirm.
